items.details: The room's enemies must be defeated in a particular order: first the rabbit-like Pols Voice, then the Keese bat, and finally the skeletal Stalfos. Throw a pot at Pols Voice instead of trying to cut through it with the sword. Keep the other enemies alive until their turn, then collect the Nightmare Key from the chest that appears. If you have already defeated them out of order, leave and reset the room before trying again rather than searching elsewhere for a missing key.

details_i18n.en: The room's enemies must be defeated in a particular order: first the rabbit-like Pols Voice, then the Keese bat, and finally the skeletal Stalfos. Throw a pot at Pols Voice instead of trying to cut through it with the sword. Keep the other enemies alive until their turn, then collect the Nightmare Key from the chest that appears. If you have already defeated them out of order, leave and reset the room before trying again rather than searching elsewhere for a missing key.
details_i18n.pt: Os inimigos da sala precisam ser derrotados nesta ordem: primeiro Pols Voice, parecido com um coelho; depois o morcego Keese; por último o esqueleto Stalfos. Arremesse um vaso em Pols Voice em vez de tentar cortá-lo com a espada. Preserve os demais até a vez deles e recolha a Nightmare Key no baú que aparece. Se já os derrotou fora de ordem, saia e reinicie a sala antes de tentar novamente, em vez de procurar outra chave pela masmorra.

items.details: Dash into the wall to dislodge Slime Eye from the ceiling. Strike the eye until its body stretches into two halves, then use a Pegasus Boots dash through the thin connection to split them fully. Fight the separated eyes while watching their jumps. Jump with Roc's Feather as an eye lands to avoid being stunned by the impact, then close in for a short sword attack. Running around without completing the split will not advance the encounter.

details_i18n.en: Dash into the wall to dislodge Slime Eye from the ceiling. Strike the eye until its body stretches into two halves, then use a Pegasus Boots dash through the thin connection to split them fully. Fight the separated eyes while watching their jumps. Jump with Roc's Feather as an eye lands to avoid being stunned by the impact, then close in for a short sword attack. Running around without completing the split will not advance the encounter.
details_i18n.pt: Corra contra a parede para derrubar Slime Eye do teto. Golpeie o olho até o corpo se alongar em duas metades e use uma corrida com as Pegasus Boots na ligação fina para separá-las. Enfrente os olhos separados observando seus saltos. Salte com Roc's Feather quando um olho aterrissar para evitar o atordoamento e aproxime-se para um ataque breve. Apenas correr pela sala sem concluir a separação não faz o confronto avançar.

items.details: Speak with Chef Bear in Animal Village to establish the singing lead, then return to Toronbo Shores and find Marin on the beach. Finish the conversation so she follows Link. Bring her back through the village to the sleeping walrus and let her singing scene complete. If you have not learned the Ballad with your Ocarina yet, speak with her while she is available in Mabe or singing in Animal Village afterward. Defeat Lanmola in Yarna Desert and recover the Angler Key; if it falls into the pit, check the cave below.

If you have not learned the Ballad with your Ocarina yet, speak with her while she is available in Mabe or singing in Animal Village afterward. Defeat Lanmola in Yarna Desert and recover the Angler Key; if it falls into the pit, check the cave below.
details_i18n.pt: Fale com Chef Bear em Animal Village para conhecer a pista da música e encontre Marin na praia de Toronbo Shores. Conclua a conversa para ela acompanhar Link. items.details: The ghost must visit its house before the grave. Enter the abandoned House by the Bay near Martha's Bay and finish its memory sequence, then travel toward the isolated grave west of the witch's hut. Approach the correct grave and let the farewell complete. In the Switch remake this grants a Fairy Bottle; the old Game Boy reward description is not the complete reward for this edition. If it still follows you, recheck the house conversation before wandering through every cemetery tomb.

details_i18n.en: The ghost must visit its house before the grave. Enter the abandoned House by the Bay near Martha's Bay and finish its memory sequence, then travel toward the isolated grave west of the witch's hut. Approach the correct grave and let the farewell complete. In the Switch remake this grants a Fairy Bottle; the old Game Boy reward description is not the complete reward for this edition. If it still follows you, recheck the house conversation before wandering through every cemetery tomb.
details_i18n.pt: O fantasma precisa visitar a casa antes da sepultura. Entre na House by the Bay perto de Martha's Bay, conclua a lembrança e siga à sepultura isolada a oeste da cabana da bruxa. Aproxime-se da sepultura correta e espere a despedida. No remake de Switch isso concede uma Fairy Bottle; a descrição da recompensa de Game Boy não representa toda a recompensa desta edição. Se ele continuar seguindo você, confira a conversa da casa antes de procurar em todas as tumbas do cemitério.

items.details: Jump or maneuver behind Master Stalfos to strike past the shield. When he collapses into a pile of bones, place a Bomb beside the pile before he rebuilds. Sword hits alone only repeat the collapse. He retreats through four marked encounter rooms, and the Hookshot is awarded after the intended final encounter. Read the note in the empty treasure chest and continue the trail rather than assuming the dungeon item vanished. Carry enough bombs to resolve every stage of the pursuit.

details_i18n.en: Jump or maneuver behind Master Stalfos to strike past the shield. When he collapses into a pile of bones, place a Bomb beside the pile before he rebuilds. Sword hits alone only repeat the collapse. He retreats through four marked encounter rooms, and the Hookshot is awarded after the intended final encounter. Read the note in the empty treasure chest and continue the trail rather than assuming the dungeon item vanished. Carry enough bombs to resolve every stage of the pursuit.
details_i18n.pt: Salte ou contorne Master Stalfos para atacar além do escudo. Quando ele virar um monte de ossos, coloque uma Bomb ao lado antes que se recomponha. Golpes de espada sozinhos apenas repetem a queda. Ele recua por quatro salas marcadas, e o Hookshot vem após o último confronto da sequência. Leia o bilhete no baú vazio e continue a perseguição em vez de presumir que o item desapareceu. Leve bombas suficientes para resolver todas as etapas.

items.details: In the Switch version, the knight pieces must finish their throw on the marked floor tiles, not merely stand upright somewhere in the room. Test one throw from a clear tile and observe the extra knight-shaped bounce after the initial landing. Adjust Link's starting position so that final bounce reaches the target; the piece's orientation matters as well. Leave a correctly placed piece alone while solving the other one. This differs from simply tossing both pieces until they happen to stand upright in older-version instructions.

details_i18n.en: In the Switch version, the knight pieces must finish their throw on the marked floor tiles, not merely stand upright somewhere in the room. Test one throw from a clear tile and observe the extra knight-shaped bounce after the initial landing. Adjust Link's starting position so that final bounce reaches the target; the piece's orientation matters as well. Leave a correctly placed piece alone while solving the other one. This differs from simply tossing both pieces until they happen to stand upright in older-version instructions.
details_i18n.pt: No Switch, os cavalos precisam terminar o arremesso nos pisos marcados, não apenas ficar em pé em qualquer lugar. Teste um lançamento de um piso livre e observe o salto adicional em formato de cavalo de xadrez após a aterrissagem inicial. Ajuste a posição de Link para esse salto final alcançar o alvo; a orientação da peça também importa. Preserve a peça colocada corretamente enquanto resolve a outra. Isso difere das instruções antigas de apenas arremessar as duas até ficarem em pé.

items.details: Clear loose pots and tiles when they threaten your movement, then avoid the floor holes that appear around the room. Facade's face on the floor is the bomb target: place a Bomb near it and move away before the blast. Repeated sword swings do not replace the explosive damage. Keep enough open space for a safe escape when new holes appear, and avoid trying to cross a disappearing tile just to place another bomb faster.

details_i18n.pt: Remova vasos e pisos soltos quando ameaçarem sua movimentação e evite os buracos que surgem na sala. With the stronger bracelet from Face Shrine, push the village weathercock monument to reveal the rooster's resting place. Play the new song beside the remains. items.details: Use the heavy ball to strike each of the four support pillars. Before throwing it across a gap or barrier, plan how Link will reach the landing side: some routes need a chest created first so the Hookshot has an anchor. Throw the ball across, then take the alternate route yourself and retrieve it. Keep track of where you left it rather than searching every floor after a stair change. Once all four pillars fall, the upper structure drops and opens the route through the rearranged tower.

details_i18n.pt: Use a esfera pesada contra os quatro pilares. Antes de jogá-la sobre um vão ou barreira, planeje como Link chegará ao outro lado: certas rotas exigem criar um baú antes para servir de apoio ao Hookshot. Arremesse a esfera, siga pela rota alternativa e recupere-a. Lembre onde a deixou em vez de procurar por todos os andares após mudar de escada. Quando os quatro pilares caírem, a estrutura superior desce e abre a passagem pela torre reorganizada.

items.title: Defeat Evil Eagle
items.description: Control your footing on the narrow arena and react to the wind attack.

description_i18n.en: Control your footing on the narrow arena and react to the wind attack.

items.details: Stay near the middle of the platform so a gust does not immediately push Link off the edge. Face the incoming feathers with the shield raised and walk against the wind when necessary. Strike when the eagle passes within reach, using the sword or an appropriate ranged tool. Falling from the platform interrupts the attempt and can undo the progress you just made in the fight, so prioritize footing over one extra hit near the edge. Reposition before the next gust instead of chasing a retreating target.

details_i18n.en: Stay near the middle of the platform so a gust does not immediately push Link off the edge. Face the incoming feathers with the shield raised and walk against the wind when necessary. Strike when the eagle passes within reach, using the sword or an appropriate ranged tool. Falling from the platform interrupts the attempt and can undo the progress you just made in the fight, so prioritize footing over one extra hit near the edge. Reposition before the next gust instead of chasing a retreating target.
details_i18n.pt: Fique perto do centro para uma rajada não empurrar Link imediatamente para fora. Encare as penas com o escudo levantado e caminhe contra o vento quando necessário. Ataque quando a águia passar ao alcance, usando espada ou uma ferramenta de longo alcance adequada. Cair interrompe a tentativa e pode desfazer o progresso recente na luta; priorize o apoio em vez de um golpe extra na borda. Reposicione-se antes da próxima rajada em vez de perseguir o alvo que recua.

items.details: The controllable floor-making blocks keep moving until their route is blocked, so plan a path that fills every required gap without cutting off a remaining pocket. Reset the room if the route becomes unusable. After obtaining the Magic Rod, melt only the ice blocks that block the intended jump or ladder route. Some side-view puzzles need a lower block preserved as a step; destroying every block can remove your foothold. Leave and re-enter to restore a failed ice layout, then take a more selective firing angle.

Some side-view puzzles need a lower block preserved as a step; destroying every block can remove your foothold. details_i18n.pt: Os blocos que criam piso continuam avançando até a rota ser bloqueada; planeje um trajeto que preencha todos os vãos exigidos sem isolar uma parte restante. Reinicie a sala se a rota ficar inviável. Após obter o Magic Rod, derreta apenas o gelo que bloqueia o salto ou a escada pretendida. Alguns desafios laterais precisam preservar um bloco inferior como degrau; destruir tudo pode eliminar o apoio. Saia e entre para restaurar o gelo e use um ângulo de tiro mais seletivo.

items.details: Finish the trading chain to obtain the Magnifying Lens, then inspect the dark book at the lower-right of Mabe's library. Copy its arrow sequence exactly. In the Switch remake the maze directions are randomized, so another player's fixed route is unreliable. After opening the Egg and dropping into its interior, enter the maze and follow the directions one room at a time until the final pit appears. If you return to the entrance, compare the next attempt with your own written sequence rather than guessing an internet pattern.

details_i18n.en: Finish the trading chain to obtain the Magnifying Lens, then inspect the dark book at the lower-right of Mabe's library. Copy its arrow sequence exactly. In the Switch remake the maze directions are randomized, so another player's fixed route is unreliable. After opening the Egg and dropping into its interior, enter the maze and follow the directions one room at a time until the final pit appears. If you return to the entrance, compare the next attempt with your own written sequence rather than guessing an internet pattern.
details_i18n.pt: Conclua as trocas para obter a Magnifying Lens e examine o livro escuro no canto inferior direito da biblioteca de Mabe. Copie exatamente a sequência de setas. No remake de Switch, as direções são aleatórias; a rota fixa de outra pessoa não é confiável. Depois de abrir o ovo e descer ao interior, entre no labirinto e siga uma direção por sala até surgir o buraco final. Se voltar à entrada, compare a nova tentativa à sequência anotada em vez de adivinhar um padrão da internet.

items.details: Fairy Bottles and Secret Medicine serve different purposes in this remake. Fill the three optional bottles with fairies and release a bottled fairy manually when you need healing; do not rely on it to revive Link automatically after defeat. Secret Medicine is a separate emergency recovery item. Bring Magic Powder for the opening Nightmare form and a Bow with arrows or the optional Boomerang for the final eye. Restock before entering the Egg so a missing consumable does not force a full retreat during the multi-form encounter.

details_i18n.en: Fairy Bottles and Secret Medicine serve different purposes in this remake. Fill the three optional bottles with fairies and release a bottled fairy manually when you need healing; do not rely on it to revive Link automatically after defeat. Secret Medicine is a separate emergency recovery item. Bring Magic Powder for the opening Nightmare form and a Bow with arrows or the optional Boomerang for the final eye. Restock before entering the Egg so a missing consumable does not force a full retreat during the multi-form encounter.
details_i18n.pt: Fairy Bottles e Secret Medicine têm funções diferentes neste remake. Encha as três garrafas opcionais com fadas e libere uma manualmente quando precisar de cura; não espere que ela reviva Link automaticamente após a derrota. Secret Medicine é um recurso de recuperação emergencial separado. Leve Magic Powder para a primeira forma do Nightmare e Bow com flechas ou o Boomerang opcional para o olho final. Reabasteça antes de entrar no ovo para evitar recuar durante o confronto por falta de consumíveis.

items.details: Use Magic Powder on the first blob form. Against the spellcasting form, return the solid energy projectile with the sword while avoiding the attack that breaks apart. Strike the Moldorm form's tail, then use charged sword attacks or Pegasus dashes against the Ganon-like form when the weapon pattern leaves an opening. The charging worm form can be hit with the Magic Rod. For the final eye, jump the rotating arms with Roc's Feather and fire arrows or the optional Boomerang only when the eye opens; the Switch version does not grant the old one-hit Boomerang finish.

Strike the Moldorm form's tail, then use charged sword attacks or Pegasus dashes against the Ganon-like form when the weapon pattern leaves an opening. The charging worm form can be hit with the Magic Rod. For the final eye, jump the rotating arms with Roc's Feather and fire arrows or the optional Boomerang only when the eye opens; the Switch version does not grant the old one-hit Boomerang finish.
details_i18n.pt: Use Magic Powder na primeira forma de gosma. Contra a forma de feiticeiro, devolva o projétil sólido com a espada e evite o ataque que se fragmenta. No olho final, salte os braços com Roc's Feather e use flechas ou o Boomerang opcional quando o olho abrir; o Switch não mantém a finalização antiga com um único Boomerang.

items.details: A valid Chamber Dungeon needs connected entrances and exits, reachable required rooms and a workable key route. Use simple rooms to reduce risk when a challenge restricts health or time, then actually clear the finished layout to earn its reward. Fill Up Your Hearts awards a Piece of Heart; Heart Shortage awards the third Fairy Bottle. After Turtle Rock and the earlier required challenges, Ticking Clock awards a separate full Heart Container. That container is not one of the thirty-two Pieces of Heart, and amiibo-exclusive rooms are unnecessary for these rewards.

details_i18n.en: A valid Chamber Dungeon needs connected entrances and exits, reachable required rooms and a workable key route. Use simple rooms to reduce risk when a challenge restricts health or time, then actually clear the finished layout to earn its reward. Fill Up Your Hearts awards a Piece of Heart; Heart Shortage awards the third Fairy Bottle. After Turtle Rock and the earlier required challenges, Ticking Clock awards a separate full Heart Container. details_i18n.pt: Uma Chamber Dungeon válida exige entradas e saídas conectadas, salas obrigatórias alcançáveis e uma rota funcional de chaves. Use salas simples quando houver restrição de vida ou tempo e conclua a organização montada para receber a recompensa. Fill Up Your Hearts concede um Piece of Heart; Heart Shortage concede a terceira Fairy Bottle. Após Turtle Rock e os desafios anteriores exigidos, Ticking Clock concede um Heart Container completo separado. Ele não é um dos trinta e dois Pieces of Heart, e essas recompensas não exigem salas exclusivas de amiibo.

items.details: The Magnifying Lens reveals the hidden Goriya contact inside the bomb-opened cave on Toronbo Shores. He exchanges the Boomerang for an eligible equipped inventory item, so choose deliberately and retain enough rupees to recover it. In the Switch remake, you can buy the traded item back from the same contact for 300 rupees and keep the Boomerang as well. This is an optional bonus after the main trading chain, not a replacement for the Lens or a required ninth instrument.

details_i18n.pt: A Magnifying Lens revela o contato Goriya na caverna aberta com bomba em Toronbo Shores. Ele troca o Boomerang por um item elegível equipado; escolha com cuidado e reserve rupias para recuperá-lo. No remake de Switch, você pode recomprar o item com o mesmo contato por 300 rupias e manter também o Boomerang.
